description: The token families: Layer-3 semantic colour roles (--echo-*), sound names, motion's whole vocabulary — the motion tokens, the spring presets, the morph feels and the CSS duration and ease steps — and the shadow recipes. Any name a component's record lists under Motion is here. Echo components are styled and moved only through these: a hex, a duration or a shadow written by hand, or a token name that isn't here, is off Echo's system.
name: get_tokens
title: Get Echo UI tokens
